uses.quote: For example, students might be encouraged to use GenAI tools to prepare for classes and seminars or workshops, and also in relation to aspects of assessment preparation.
This Policy is based on the position that the use of GenAI tools for assessments is acceptable provided such tools are used responsibly, and academic integrity is maintained.
Along with other Universities, our position is not to prohibit the use of GenAI

decided_by.quote: This Policy is based on the position that the use of GenAI tools for assessments is acceptable provided such tools are used responsibly, and academic integrity is maintained.
Course teams working with Learning and Teaching Directors and Co-ordinators should determine how GenAI can be incorporated into programme design and learning and teaching activity.
There may be assessment contexts where the use of GenAI tools is not appropriate, and module tutors should make this clear in assignment briefs.

duty.quote: the proper acknowledgement of the role played by GenAI tool in developing the work.

records.quote: The importance of students maintaining a record of how they planned and constructed their assignment, detailing the use of GenAI where appropriate, should be embedded as part of good academic practice.

referencing.quote: there should be clarity for students on how they should acknowledge and reference the use of GenAI (see Cite them right guidance here).
